Overview

Pietermaritzburg is a city in KwaZulu-Natal with a population of 618,000. The capital of KwaZulu-Natal, known for its Victorian architecture, gardens, and historic Midlands Meander. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
